plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly productivity coaching: daily planning (/today, /energy), end-of-day capture (/checkin), weekly scheduling (/plan-week) and review (/weekly), life-direction reviews (/review), goal-to-project alignment (/align), project lifecycle (/intake, /breakdown, /reentry, /sunset), idea capture (/spark), brain dump (/dump), task triage (/triage), decision journaling (/decide), and pattern analysis (momentum, overdue-rescue) with adaptive tone calibration

plugins.name: commits
plugins.description: Format-aware atomic commits for git and jj (Jujutsu). Auto-detects VCS and commit message style from repo context.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: A suite of conversational thinking tools — reflect (Socratic mirror, never recommends, always saves) and mull (thinking partner, probes AND contributes opinions, saves substantive sessions only).

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Dialectical decision analysis: dispatch parallel advocate agents to research opposing perspectives, optionally fact-check claims, challenge the consensus with devil's advocacy, and independently synthesize a verdict. Three modes (Quick/Standard/Deep) control pipeline depth. Not for factual lookups or simple preferences.

plugins.name: doing
plugins.description: Time tracking with doing CLI. Start/stop tasks, backdate entries, query work history.

plugins.name: homelab-ops
plugins.description: Create, troubleshoot, and migrate Docker services in a Jinja2-templated homelab with Tailscale networking, Traefik routing, and 1Password secrets

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Job search toolkit for application tracking, work documentation, and interview preparation. Integrates with Obsidian vault and Todoist.

plugins.name: librarian
plugins.description: Curates, catalogs, retrieves, and maintains your library of notes and knowledge in an Obsidian vault. Workflow-shaped (Capture / Process / Retrieve / Maintain) and agent-mediated (skills draft, agents execute). 16 skills + 4 agents + 7 references, coupled to the vault conventions in ~/Loose Ends/.claude/rules/{wiki.md,catalog.md}.

plugins.name: ndr
plugins.description: Nested decision records — atomic markdown decision atoms in your Obsidian vault with supersession-aware reading. Capture engineering decisions from any chat (/capture-decision), query the corpus by topic with automatic supersession-chain walking (/decisions <topic>), ground a coding session in relevant prior decisions before edits (/ground), audit code against current decision heads with /drift-check, and bootstrap vault content on first install (/ndr-bootstrap).

plugins.name: permissions-manager
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code permissions and troubleshoot permission errors

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive Python development skills: write Pythonic code, debug systematically, and fix failing tests

plugins.name: shake-tune
plugins.description: Interpret Klippain Shake Tune results for 3D printers: diagnose issues from PNG graphs, explain findings, recommend fixes, and track results over time. Supports belt comparison, input shaper, vibration profile, axes map, and excitation tests.

plugins.name: spec-flow
plugins.description: Personal SDLC scaffolding for AI-assisted development. A lightweight, ephemeral 'contract' between user and AI drives each code change from idea to done; the durable layer (CLAUDE.md, ndr atoms, README) lives elsewhere.
